gloss: to hand over, to deliver in person

definitions.gloss: to hand over, to deliver in person, to hand to
definitions.explanation: To give something directly to someone by hand, rather than sending it by mail or through an intermediary. Emphasizes the physical, face-to-face delivery.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}を{直接|ちょくせつ}{手渡|てわた}した。
examples.english: I handed over the letter directly.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}が{賞状|しょうじょう}を{一人|ひとり}ずつ{手渡|てわた}した。
examples.english: The company president handed out the certificates one by one.

examples.japanese: {大切|たいせつ}な{書類|しょるい}なので、{郵送|ゆうそう}ではなく{手渡|てわた}しでお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Since these are important documents, please deliver them by hand rather than by mail.
examples.notes: {手渡|てわた}し is the noun form meaning 'hand delivery.'

notes:
{手渡|てわた}す emphasizes direct, face-to-face delivery. It is used when the personal nature of the handoff is important.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

PATTERN:
- AがBに〜を{手渡|てわた}す: A hands ~ to B

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直接|ちょくせつ}{手渡|てわた}す: to hand over directly
- {手渡|てわた}しで{届|とど}ける: to deliver by hand
- {手渡|てわた}し: hand delivery (noun form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {渡|わた}す: to hand over, to pass (more general)
- {届|とど}ける: to deliver
